title: Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices
description: Withdrawn-list row 16 states: "DoS.CO.CSITEG/SEC.7/31.01.015/2023-24 — Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices — November 07, 2023". Paragraph 229 of the stored Payments Banks Direction and paragraph 224 of the stored AIFI Direction state that repeal was communicated by circular DoS.CO.PPG.66/11.01.005/2026-27 dated July 31, 2026. Which 2026 Direction succeeds it is this project's reading of the two texts, not a statement by RBI.
